# Rubber duck: yellow body and head, peach beak, dark eyes, 0.62 m tall. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Body --base-color 1.0000 0.9255 0.4275 --no-slot
material new Beak --base-color 1.0000 0.6549 0.3882 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.3255 0.0118 0.2941 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.25 --location 0.000 0.000 0.210
scale 1.0 1.2 0.82
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh ico-sphere --name Head --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.17 --location 0.000 -0.130 0.460
material assign Body
add mesh ico-sphere --name Wing --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.13 --location 0.000 0.040 0.240
scale 2.1 0.95 0.62
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh cone --name Beak --vertices 6 --radius1 0.08 --radius2 0.02 --depth 0.16 --location 0.000 -0.320 0.430 --rotation 90 0 0
material assign Beak
add mesh cone --name Tail --vertices 4 --radius1 0.09 --radius2 0 --depth 0.17 --location 0.000 0.300 0.330 --rotation -55 0 0
material assign Body
add mesh cube --name EyeL --size 0.06 --location -0.085 -0.270 0.510
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name EyeR --size 0.06 --location 0.085 -0.270 0.510
material assign Eye
select all
shade flat
export duck.glb
